en: A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large, ornate late‑Victorian/Queen Anne style house with multiple gables, bay windows, and a wrap‑around porch. The house is surrounded by a lush garden filled with dense flowering shrubs, palms, and other subtropical plants. A set of concrete steps leads up from the sidewalk to the front garden, with manicured hedges of flowers lining both sides. A broad sidewalk and neatly cut lawn run along the street in the foreground. The overall scene suggests an affluent residential neighborhood in a warm climate. Along the bottom border, some handwritten or printed numerals and letters appear, partly cut off.
